title: The seed that travelled
subject: Reading
description: An original village story about small things making a difference.
body: Tara found a seed beside the school gate. “You are a very small thing,” she said. She put it in her pocket and carried it home.
Her grandfather found a little clay pot. Tara filled it with soil and planted the seed. Every morning she gave it water. For many days, nothing happened.
One morning, a green leaf pushed through the soil. Tara ran to call her grandfather. “It was working all the time,” he said. “We just could not see it yet.”
When the plant grew tall, Tara brought it back to school. Her friends each planted a seed of their own. A small thing had started something bigger.
question: What does Tara learn from growing the seed?
options: Growth can happen before we see it
